summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Decision Drive (React Three Fiber). All 8 requested features verified end-to-end on live preview URL. Both 3D Canvases (solo + VS) render without runtime errors. Score increments, pause/resume works, localStorage persistence works, all routes navigate correctly. No R3F applyProps / WebGLMultipleRenderTargets errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: WebGL driver emits performance warning 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' (4x then auto-suppresses). Not a bug; likely from headless GL driver. Safe to ignore on real GPUs.

Minor: VsGame onLivesChange uses prev.alive via closure - this is fine but tied to current behavior of GameField setting lives then immediately calling onGameOver. Already working but be aware if you change the lives callback ordering.
seed_data_creation: Injected one localStorage entry into tunnel_runner_scores_solo to verify score row rendering on /scores page
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified flows: (1) Menu /, all 4 nav buttons -> correct routes. (2) /play loads 1 canvas, p1-score increments (000020 -> 000334 in 2.5s), p1-lives/p1-level/pause-btn/menu-btn all visible. (3) 'p' key opens pause-overlay, resume-btn closes it. (4) /vs renders 2 canvases, p1-score and p2-score both increment independently (000117->000524 and 000318->000725). (5) /how-to-play renders all 6 level cards (GENESIS, SURGE, PYRE, VOID, INFERNO, TRANSCEND). (6) /scores empty state shows 'NO RUNS RECORDED', tab-solo/tab-vs/clear-btn visible, both tabs show empty state initially, seeded score row renders correctly. No page errors, only benign WebGL performance warnings.
